denial_type_rationale: Pre-service authorization for lumbar fusion denied under medical policy MVP-SP-07.
reasons_for: Criterion 1 allows 4 mm translation OR 10 degrees of angular motion; the flexion-extension report documents 11 degrees, so the reviewer applied only half of the criterion.
The payer agreed criteria 2-4 are met (symptoms, more than 3 months of conservative care, imaging correlation).
The patient reports nicotine abstinence since {{QUIT}}, more than 6 weeks before the planned surgery.
reasons_against: No negative cotinine result is in the record; Criterion 5 cannot be met without it.
Translation (3.5 mm) is below the 4 mm threshold, so the instability argument rests entirely on angulation.
recommended_strategy: Obtain the cotinine result first. If it is negative, appeal on both points: show the 11-degree angulation under the 'OR' clause of Criterion 1 and attach the negative cotinine test. If it is positive, defer the appeal and reschedule surgery.
